blocks.x: Online BCA Program - Big Data Analytics
Hadoop | Spark | Real-Time Processing | Scalable Pipelines

This elective covers the processing and analysis of large-scale datasets using big-data frameworks such as Hadoop and Spark. It includes batch analytics, real-time stream processing, distributed storage, and the design of scalable data pipelines used in modern enterprise environments.
Concepts of large-scale data processing, distributed computing & data ecosystems.
HDFS, MapReduce, YARN, Hive, Pig, and scalable batch processing.
RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, MLlib & real-time stream processing.
Exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, dashboards & BI tools.
Kafka, Flink, workflow orchestration & enterprise-grade scalable pipelines.
Designs and builds scalable data pipelines using Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and distributed systems for enterprise data workflows.
Analyzes business data, generates insights, builds dashboards, and supports decision-making using analytical and visualization tools.
Builds Spark streaming and batch applications using RDDs, DataFrames, and MLlib for high-performance analytics.
Manages Hadoop clusters, configures HDFS, monitors performance, and ensures reliability of distributed big-data systems.
Builds predictive models, applies machine learning, and works with large datasets to solve business problems.
Designs streaming architectures using Kafka, Flink, or Spark Streaming for real-time analytics and event processing.
Builds and maintains ETL workflows, handles data cleaning, transformation, and ensures high-quality structured datasets.
Designs large-scale data architectures, storage models, and enterprise data strategies using modern big-data platforms.
Develops ML models and integrates them into big-data environments using Spark MLlib and scalable pipelines.
Secures large datasets, ensures data governance, compliance, privacy, and risk-free big-data operations.
